goals.name: UX Research Goal Harness
goals.description: UX Research Goal Harness [ux-research-session] — compiled from capabilities/harnesses/hC-03-ux-research.yaml
goals.gate: All 11 capability gates passed with artifacts under artifacts/uxr/<slug>/

gates.name: 0.1 Startup phrase spoken and session type declared before any w
gates.description: Startup phrase spoken and session type declared before any work begins

gates.name: 0.2 RIG operating procedures loaded and declared mandatory for t
gates.description: RIG operating procedures loaded and declared mandatory for this session

gates.name: 0.4 Harness tuple declared verbatim: H_ux_research(identity, gat
gates.description: Harness tuple declared verbatim: H_ux_research(identity, gates, dod, failure_protocol, self_improvement)

gates.name: 0.5 Goal-card for the session written to artifacts/<session>/goa
gates.description: Goal-card for the session written to artifacts/<session>/goal-card.yaml with an executable done_test

gates.name: 1.1 Research question and falsifiable hypotheses written before
gates.description: Research question and falsifiable hypotheses written before any participant contact
gates.command: artifacts/uxr/<slug>/plan.md with question, >=3 hypotheses, method, and analysis plan

gates.name: 1.2 Participant screener documented: inclusion/exclusion criteri
gates.description: Participant screener documented: inclusion/exclusion criteria and recruitment source
gates.command: artifacts/uxr/<slug>/screener.md with criteria and per-participant fit scores

gates.name: 1.3 Consent captured for every session; recordings/notes stored
gates.description: Consent captured for every session; recordings/notes stored with provenance and PII handling declared
gates.command: artifacts/uxr/<slug>/consent/ contains one record per participant; PII redaction statement in plan.md

gates.name: 2.1 Session notes or transcripts stored per participant with tim
gates.description: Session notes or transcripts stored per participant with timestamped raw capture
gates.command: one file per participant under artifacts/uxr/<slug>/sessions/ with header metadata (date, duration, modality)

gates.name: 2.2 Coding pass completed: observations tagged with a stated cod
gates.description: Coding pass completed: observations tagged with a stated codebook
gates.command: artifacts/uxr/<slug>/codebook.yaml + coded observations CSV with `observation_id, participant_id, code, quote` columns

gates.name: 2.3 Theme clustering produced from coded observations (affinity
gates.description: Theme clustering produced from coded observations (affinity mapping), not from memory
gates.command: artifacts/uxr/<slug>/themes.csv mapping each theme to >=2 observation_ids from >=2 participants

gates.name: 2.4 Saturation check: last N sessions produced no new themes, N
gates.description: Saturation check: last N sessions produced no new themes, N stated
gates.command: saturation table in report: new-themes-per-session counts converging to zero; N >= 2

gates.name: 3.1 Insight statements written in 'we observed X, which means Y,
gates.description: Insight statements written in 'we observed X, which means Y, therefore Z' form with evidence links
gates.command: report insights section; every insight cites theme IDs from themes.csv

gates.name: 3.2 Every recommendation traces to at least one insight ID; orph
gates.description: Every recommendation traces to at least one insight ID; orphan recommendations removed
gates.command: traceability table `recommendation_id -> insight_id -> theme_id` in report; orphan count = 0

gates.name: 3.3 Persona or journey-map artifacts updated as a diff, not over
gates.description: Persona or journey-map artifacts updated as a diff, not overwritten blindly
gates.command: `git diff` (or dated before/after files) for persona/journey artifacts committed with the report

gates.name: 3.4 Findings readout produced for stakeholders with confidence l
gates.description: Findings readout produced for stakeholders with confidence levels per finding
gates.command: artifacts/uxr/<slug>/readout.md with per-finding confidence (high/med/low) and evidence density

preconditions.startup_phrase: UX research mode: participants are people, insights are traceable, saturation is proven.
preconditions.bms_bias: A1-A2 preferred; A3 permitted for thematic synthesis; A4 only with approval

self_improvement.update_trigger: same gate fails 3+ times across sessions

success_conditions: All 11 capability gates passed with artifacts under artifacts/uxr/<slug>/
Primary objective achieved: traceable insight-to-recommendation chain delivered
Consent and provenance records complete for every participant
Identity closure: coordinate, verdict, and next safe action stated
failure_states: stop gate(s) 1.3: session halts; human Gate-D approval required before any continuation or outward action
halt gate(s) 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 3.1, 3.2: no progress without gate evidence
degrade gate(s) 2.4, 3.3, 3.4: continue with deficit logged in the Definition of Done waiver
quality_criteria: Startup phrase spoken and session type declared before any work begins
RIG operating procedures loaded and declared mandatory for this session
Harness tuple declared verbatim: H_ux_research(identity, gates, dod, failure_protocol, self_improvement)
Goal-card for the session written to artifacts/<session>/goal-card.yaml with an executable done_test
Research question and falsifiable hypotheses written before any participant contact
Participant screener documented: inclusion/exclusion criteria and recruitment source
Consent captured for every session; recordings/notes stored with provenance and PII handling declared
Session notes or transcripts stored per participant with timestamped raw capture
Coding pass completed: observations tagged with a stated codebook
Theme clustering produced from coded observations (affinity mapping), not from memory
Saturation check: last N sessions produced no new themes, N stated
Insight statements written in 'we observed X, which means Y, therefore Z' form with evidence links
Every recommendation traces to at least one insight ID; orphan recommendations removed
Persona or journey-map artifacts updated as a diff, not overwritten blindly
Findings readout produced for stakeholders with confidence levels per finding

final_rule: No improvement entry, no session complete.
Outward action (publish, send, deploy) requires Gate-D approval — v0 is local-only.
Every ux-research-session session leaves the system stronger than it found it.
